div.head: I Cn 5.4
div.ab: ⁊ gyf he ladian wylle, geladige þonne be dæde mæðe, swa mid þryfealdre swa mid anfealdre lade, be ðam þe seo dæd sy.
⁊ gif he hine ladian wille, geladiage þonne be dade maðe, swa mid þrifealde [swa mid anfealdre] lade, be þam þe seo dade sy.
Si se purgare uelit, secundum facti mensuram sit, uel per triplicem negationem uel per simplicem (singularem).
⁊ gyf he ladian wille, geladige þonne be dæde mæðe, swa mid þryfealdre swa mid anfealdre lade, be ðam þe seo dæd sy.
And gyf he ladian wylle, geladige þonne be dæde mæðe: swa mid þryfealdre swa mid anfealdre lade, be ðam þe seo dæd sy.
And if he seeks to clear himself, he shall do so in proportion to the deed, either by the triple mode of proof, or by the simple, in accordance with the nature of the deed.
And if he wishes to clear himself, he shall do so in the manner appropriate for the offense: either the triple mode of proof or the single, whichever the deed calls for.
Und wenn er sich reinigen will, dann reinige er sich nach Verhältniss der That entweder durch dreifachen oder durch einfachen Reinigungsbeweis, je nachdem die That ist.
And if he wishes to clear himself, then let him clear himself according to the gravity of the deed, either by the threefold or by the single clearing, according to what the deed is.
div.note: A lacks ‘swa mid anfealdre’, supplied by Liebermann. Liebermann compares VIII Atr 27.1.
